name: AnimeVerse Fest Reno
blurb: Reno stop of the Animeverse Fest multi-city anime convention tour, with voice actors, cosplay, gaming and live performances.
notes: Animeverse Fest is a multi-city brand (separate shows in Reno, Baton Rouge, Pittsburgh, Houston and others are promoted from the same wp-site); only the Reno-specific page (animeversefest.com/reno/) was used for this file, never the generic landing page. That page still shows the past 'SEPTEMBER 19TH-20TH, 2026' edition and the footer already reads 'ZIMMAD EVENTS, LLC 2027', but no specific 2027 Reno date is posted yet and a search for 'Animeverse Fest Reno 2027 dates' found none either, so editions is empty and the last confirmed edition is recorded instead.
